page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top centre. Left margin holds three notes beside the heading and first paragraph. Full-width text runs down the page, ending with a line broken at the foot of the page.

main_text.p: Hunc Strabo l. 1. & 15. vocat Temo-nem, & maximis Imperatoribus prisci ævi adscribit, atq; etiam superatis Herculeis columnis Europæ victri-cia arma intulisse vult.
main_text.head: IMPERIA EUROPÆA, I. GRÆCORUM.III. Europæa, & qvidē(1) Græcorum.
Periodus I.
Cap. I.
main_text.p: Gracia initio inter varios reges divisa fuit.qvod primū varios Reges,
main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Inter præcipua & antiquissima Græcorum Regna hæc fuerunt: Sicyoniorum, Argivorum, Spartanorum, Messeniorum, Ariarathum, Atheniensium, Thebanorum, Thessalorum.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.

page.notes: The margin notes are read from the scan and placed beside the lines they stand next to. The "(1)" mark is not clearly tied to a text reference. The left-margin "qvidē" may be read as "qvidē" or "quidē" (doubtful). The right margin shows only show-through and is left out. The italic "Gracia" is read as "Gracia" with a long-tailed letter. Its italic form is uncertain.
